description: Sticky pistons moving slime and honey blocks: standing on slime pushed up (launched up, landing sneaking), then pulled back down; standing east of slime pushed east (launched east) on stone and on ice, each pulled back after; standing on honey pushed east and pulled back (the honey carries the player both ways). Obsidian under the sideways slime and honey keeps them from sticking to the floor.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
